title: docs(permissions,qa): the unscoped admin_full_access anchor confers platform-admin standing under single only
body:
Part of #19145
Clause-②: no

Carriers 1 and 2 of #19145 (the two documentation carriers), plus one more carrier of the same claim that the sweep found in the same tree. Carriers 3 (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` `RUN_LIFECYCLE_DENY_MESSAGE`) and 4 (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts` `role.description`) are **not touched here**. They belong to other lanes, and a split has been requested from triage. #19145 remains open for them.

## The rule as the code decides it (all at `2bbb4623`)

- `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts:865`: `legacyGrantAnchorRetired = postureEnforcesWall(resolveTenancyPosture())`. This reads the **requested** posture (the environment), not the effective one, so a walled deployment that is running degraded is still treated as walled.
- `packages/spec/src/security/tenancy-posture.ts:54`: `postureEnforcesWall` returns `posture !== 'single'`. The walled postures are `group` and `isolated`.
- `resolve-authz-context.ts:958`: an unscoped `admin_full_access` row sets `hasPlatformAdminGrant` only when `!legacyGrantAnchorRetired`, so only under `single`. The set's name and capabilities are still pushed on every posture, so the anchor is retired but the grant is not (pinned at `resolve-authz-context.platform-admin-config.test.ts:404`).
- `resolve-authz-context.ts:1009`: the config anchor (`OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, verified stored row) has no posture gate and confers on every posture.
- The request path has no per-request pointer any more. `reportLegacyPlatformAdminGrant` and `resetLegacyPlatformAdminGrantReport` are gone (absence pinned at `platform-admin.test.ts:267`, with positive controls). The only operator-facing line left is the boot-time fail-closed error at `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:897`, which names the legacy holder at `:912`.
- The `single` half is described as it ships. Its fate is #11979's (Choice 4B), and nothing here anticipates that decision.

## Per carrier: old text, new text, code site

**1. `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` (combination semantics, step 3)**
- Old: "That posture is derived at one site from **two anchors**, either of which is sufficient: the configured administrator list … and an **unscoped `admin_full_access` grant** row."
- New: The anchors depend on the tenancy posture. The configured list is sufficient under every posture. The unscoped grant row is sufficient only under `single`. Under `group` / `isolated` it is no longer an anchor: the set still grants what any held set grants, but it confers no `PLATFORM_ADMIN` standing, so standing comes from configuration alone. Adds a link to the tenancy-modes page.
- Code: `resolve-authz-context.ts:865`, `:958`, `:1009`; `tenancy-posture.ts:54`.

**1b. `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` (who holds `admin_full_access`). The sweep found this; it was not in the card.**
- Old: "derived at a single site from **two anchors**, and either one is sufficient" and, for the grant row, "It still confers standing, and it is **deprecated**: a deployment resolving through it logs a pointer, once per process, at the configuration line that re-anchors it."
- New: Which anchor is sufficient depends on posture. The config anchor is read under every posture. The grant row confers standing under `single` only. Under walled postures it is not an anchor, and nothing is logged about it per request. If a walled deployment holding such a row has no usable configured administrator, the boot log reports zero administrators, names the account holding the row, and points at `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`.
- Code: as above, plus `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts:897` / `:912` for the boot line.

**2. `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json`, item `access-security.platform-owner-email-anchor`, revision 1 to 2 (history appended; revision 1 untouched)**
- Step 6. Old: "grep the process log for the once-per-process legacy-grant re-anchor pointer". New: run the #11663 L5 posture-split unit pins named in clause 6 and cite their output. The step states that there is no live log line to grep and that the only operator-facing line left is the boot-time fail-closed error.
- Clause 6. Old: "the legacy anchor is honoured and loudly re-pointed … the once-per-process [authz] pointer names the OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL config line … (reportLegacyPlatformAdminGrant, platform-admin.ts)", oracle `log`. New: the legacy grant is an anchor under `single` only, and a silent one. Under a walled posture (`postureEnforcesWall`, the requested posture) it confers no `PLATFORM_ADMIN` standing, although the held set keeps its capabilities. The config anchor still confers on that rig. The request path logs nothing. The oracle is now `test` (the L5 describes in `resolve-authz-context.platform-admin-config.test.ts` and `platform-admin.test.ts`), and the clause records that a change to the `single` half is #11979's to make.
- Source parenthetical. Old: "… matchesConfiguredPlatformAdmin verified-only, reportLegacyPlatformAdminGrant". New: "… resolvePlatformAdminEmails loud-once resolve, matchesConfiguredPlatformAdmin verified-only" (all live symbols). Adds two anchors: `resolve-authz-context.ts#legacyGrantAnchorRetired` and `tenancy-posture.ts#postureEnforcesWall`.
- The same claim appeared elsewhere in the item, so these parts were fixed to keep the item true:
  - Step 1 booted `isolated` with the variable unset. That boot is refused today (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts:551`).
  - Under a walled posture the seeded admin holds no grant-anchored standing, because no row is written and an existing row confers nothing. That made clause 1, clause 3 and the seeded-admin both-sides control false under `isolated`.
  - The live legs now boot `single` (the zero-config default) and keep it across restarts. Clause 1, the persona and the knownGap name the posture. A walled variant was added. `automated.ref` now says clause 6 is test-only.
- Code: as above, plus `auth-plugin.ts:551`.

## Verification (head `2505ca61`)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derived 45 commands. All 45 were run and each exit code was recorded. All 45 exited 0. `check:skill-examples` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: client-react not built). That is not a measurement. It exited 0 after `@objectstack/client-react` / `@objectstack/client` were built. `--ran` reconciles as 45 derived / 45 run / 0 unrun.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: OK. Symbol anchors went from 620/638 to 622/640 resolved. The `areas/access-security.json` anchor census went from **44 to 46** against its floor of 44, and the floor and ledger are unchanged.
- The control-byte self-scan over the three files found 0 hits.
- Not measured locally, and declared to CI: the Build Docs job, the Test Core shards and the type-check lanes that the derivation lists as CI-only.

## Changeset

None. `content/docs/**` and `docs/qa/**` are not in any published package's `files[]` (checked over every non-private `package.json`), so nothing publishes. This is `skip-changeset` territory, and no label was written by this seat, per the dispatch.

## Acceptance notes

- **Sweep** (`content/docs/**`, `docs/qa/**`, excluding the auto-generated `references/` and `releases/`) for `either of which`, `two anchors`, `once-per-process`, `reportLegacyPlatformAdminGrant`, `unscoped admin_full_access`, `re-anchor` and `admin_full_access`:
  - The only other carrier of the claim was `permission-sets.mdx:167-183`, fixed above.
  - `authorization.mdx` (validity-window and deactivation sections): "an expired / deactivated unscoped `admin_full_access` grant no longer derives `platform_admin`" is still true on every posture, so it was left alone.
  - `deployment/self-hosting.mdx` first-boot section: already posture-correct.
- **File surface beyond the claim:** `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` is outside the claim's declared file surface. It was fixed in place because it is the same defect class, a mechanical prose fix in the same tree, and no other claim holds it. The claim's surface needs to be widened by the seat.
- **Step 1 of the checklist item** could not run as written, independently of #19136, because an `isolated` boot with the variable unset is refused. It was fixed in the same edit because the item's other clauses depended on the boot posture.
